Resize Image to 100KB for Railway Forms

Compress your photograph to exactly 100KB as required by Indian Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) exams — including RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, and JE applications. Our free tool uses Canvas API-based binary search compression to reliably hit the 100KB target within ±2KB. At 100KB, photo quality is excellent — suitable for official Railway ID verification. Entirely browser-based, zero uploads, no registration.
